does_not_do: It needs historical data loaded into its own bundle format and does not supply market data.
focus_reason: A tested, event-driven backtester with 2 open issues and a release on 2026-10-25; it needs data loaded into bundles before any test runs.
measured_against: Need: test a rule-based portfolio or trading idea against historical data.
tests_ci: A tests/ directory; quick and full CI test workflows and wheel builds.
what_it_is: A maintained fork of Zipline, the event-driven backtesting library first built at Quantopian.
